name: Qui-Gon Jinn
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Qui-Gon's green lightsaber hilt planted beside a Gungan energy shield on a Sacred Place stone plinth
A reed-pipe totem and Otoh Gunga sigil banner draped in swamp moss and luminescent Naboo lichen
Miniature Boss Nass ceremonial staff crossed with a Jedi holocron on a bongo-submarine viewport base
vehicleSuggestions: Gungan bongo submarine — iconic transport through Naboo's underwater core to Otoh Gunga
Fambaa-mounted energy shield — Gungan Grand Army battle formation from the Battle of Naboo
Kaadu cavalry — fast Gungan mounts used in the assault on the Trade Federation

factionTrait.name: Sentinal Champion
factionTrait.text: A sentinel moves the turn token +1 step when they have their banner on an objective hex during the end phase.

uniqueTraits.name: Trust Your Instincts
uniqueTraits.text: If Qui-Gon Jinn does not have any wounds, his skills have +2 {accuracy_die}.

ultimate.name: I Cannot Fight a War for You
ultimate.text: Plot phase only. Qui-Gon Jinn may make a claim action. Then choose {protection_boon} or {move_boon}. Friendly models within range gain the boon you chose.

plotSkills.name: Concentrate on the Moment
plotSkills.text: Remove up to 2 of Qui-Gon Jinn's wounds.

clashSkills.name: Concentrate on the Moment
clashSkills.text: Remove up to 2 of Qui-Gon Jinn's wounds.

clashSkills.name: Opening Strike
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Qui-Gon Jinn may use Follow-Through Cut this turn as a bonus action.

clashSkills.name: Follow-Through Cut
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Qui-Gon Jinn may move up to 1 hex.

traits.name: Swamp Born
traits.text: Gungan Warriors may enter objective hexes.

plotSkills.name: Energy Shield Up
plotSkills.text: This skill may be used only while on an objective hex. Gain {dodge_boon} and {protection_boon}.

plotSkills.name: Bombad Leap
plotSkills.text: You may place each Gungan Warrior in a hex up to 2 hexes from its current hex.

clashSkills.name: Mesa Got It!
clashSkills.text: Move a friendly banner that is within range up to 1 hex toward this Gungan Warrior.

clashSkills.name: Clumsy Tongue Grab
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move target up to 1 hex toward this Gungan Warrior.
